subject: Renewal roadmap demo: pre-QBR dry run & venue/tech check
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@medaliance.com>, Tom Burns <tomb@medaliance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal roadmap demo: pre-QBR dry run & venue/tech check

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for confirming the renewal QBR on May 14. Before the exec walkthrough, we'd like to run a short dry run to: 1) validate the demo flow, 2) confirm model version and quantization settings we'll serve during the QBR, and 3) do a venue/AV tech check for any on-site connectivity.

Would either of these windows work for you next week (PT):
- Tue May 11, 08:30–09:15
- Wed May 12, 09:00–09:45

If those are tight, please suggest one alternative and we will accommodate. I've attached the updated QBR agenda and a venue map so your onsite team can confirm the AV points.

Notes / asks:
- Elena: can procurement confirm whether the standard SOW/terms require any changes for the dedicated instance? (CC'd Tom / procurement)
- Priyom: can you bring a provisioning key for a temporary test cluster during the dry run?
- Marissa: would you own the runbook dry-run and recording permissions?

Attachments: Medaliance_QBR_Agenda_v3.pdf (agenda), Venue_Layout.png (venue map)

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Elena Morales <elena@medaliance.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Burns <tomb@medaliance.com>, procurement@medaliance.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal roadmap demo: pre-QBR dry run & venue/tech check

Ben —

Thanks — appreciate the agenda and map. Quick note on availability: procurement has a scheduled review on Tue May 11 afternoon and won't be available earlier that day. Wed May 12 at 09:00 PT looks better for our program team, but Tom and I also want to confirm an AV tech on-site that morning (should be fine).

A couple of items from our side:
- Procurement (procurement@medaliance.com) will send a short checklist; can your team share any requirements for data handling during the dry run?
- We need to confirm recording permissions and whether Redwood will keep the recording for QA. If so, please indicate storage duration and access controls.
- Onsite support: can you bring a USB with a local copy of the demo and a wired fallback? Our venue sometimes blocks outbound streaming.

If Wed 05/12 09:00 PT is acceptable to you, please lock it in. Otherwise propose a 30–45 minute slot on Mon 05/10 morning (we prefer avoiding Mon if at all possible).

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director, Clinical Ops — Medaliance Health
elena@medaliance.com | +1 617-555-0142

Date: Thu, 6 May 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal roadmap demo: pre-QBR dry run & venue/tech check

Priyom / Marissa —

Forwarding Elena's reply. She prefers Wed 05/12 09:00 PT, but procurement may need to weigh in. Proposed plan (short):

Goal: confirm demo flow, pin model version, validate AV + recording permissions, run provisioning test.

Action items:
- Priyom: please provision a temporary test key for a small dedicated instance and an alternative temporary endpoint (expiration 48 hrs). Bring a wired fallback configuration for the demo. Attach Runbook_Checklist.xlsx and note where keys are stored.
- Marissa: own the dry-run runbook and recording permission flow. If venue blocks streaming, we'll fall back to local recording and shared link. Confirm who on our side will be the recording custodian.
- Karthik: please confirm which model variant we'll pin for the QBR (we discussed 2.7B quantized variant last week) and whether we should use kv-cache priming for the session.

Can you confirm feasibility by EOD today? If Wed 05/12 09:00 PT works for Medaliance, we'll send a calendar invite and loop procurement.

Attachments: Runbook_Checklist.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Ben

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal roadmap demo: pre-QBR dry run & venue/tech check

Confirming Wed May 12 / 09:00 PT is workable, but to keep margin I'd prefer Tue May 11 08:30 PT if Medaliance can make that earlier slot. If Elena is set on Wed, that's fine — I will: 
- Provision a temporary test key (expires 48h after the dry run) and share a short access note in the calendar invite.
- Stand up a wired fallback endpoint and a small local playback artifact in case streaming is blocked.
- Loop Karthik for model-pin and Marissa for runbook handoff.

Karthik — can you confirm model-pin by EOD? Marissa — can you confirm recording custodian?

— Priyom
